introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Computer Science 2 (0595), ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2026. Duration: Two hours.**

Answer any FIVE questions. All questions carry 20 marks each. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators or Phones are NOT allowed.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) Ivy powers on her computer and waits for up to 60 seconds for it to be ready for her to use. The computer automatically runs instructions that enable it to identify various devices in the computer system. After this identification, the operating system is loaded into the RAM.

(i) What is the name of the process from when Ivy powers on the computer to when it loads the operating system onto the RAM? (1 mark)

(ii) State where in the computer system the instructions to identify the various devices is stored. (1 mark)

(iii) Explain two possible reasons why Ivy had to wait for up to 60 second for the computer to be set for her use. (4 marks)

(iv) What is an operating system? (2 marks)

(v) Give any three functions of an operating system. (3 marks)

(b) (i) Name and state the roles of any two components of an information system. (4 marks)

(ii) Describe any one role of each of the following components of the a computer's Central Processing Unit.

- ALU (2 marks)
- Control unit (1 mark)
- Registers (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Components of an information system (4 marks, 2 each).** Any two of:

- **Hardware:** the physical equipment (computers, input, output and storage devices, network devices) used to collect, process, store and output the data.
- **Software:** the programs (system and application software) that tell the hardware how to process the data.
- **Data:** the raw facts that are input and processed to produce information.
- **People (users and IT staff):** they operate the system, supply the data and use the information produced.
- **Procedures:** the rules and instructions that define how the system is used and managed.

**(ii) Components of the CPU (4 marks).**

- **ALU (arithmetic and logic unit) (2 marks):** carries out the arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and the logic operations (comparisons such as greater than or equal to, and AND, OR, NOT) on the data.
- **Control unit (1 mark):** fetches each instruction from memory, decodes it and sends control signals that direct and coordinate the other parts of the computer to carry it out.
- **Registers (1 mark):** small, very fast storage locations inside the CPU that hold the data, instructions or addresses being processed at that moment (for example the program counter and the accumulator).
